content: Yesuusanne Niqodimoosa
Farsaaweta yaraape gidida, Ayhudeta halaqay, Niqodimoosa geetetiya issi addey de7ees.

Niqodimoosi qamma Yesuusako yidi, “Astamaariyaw, neeni Xoossay kiitida astamaare gideysa nuuni eroos. Ayis giiko, Xoossay iyara doonna ixiko ha neeni oothiya malaata oothanaw danda7iya asi baawa” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Taani new tuma odayis; oonika zaari yeletonna ixiko Xoossaa kawotethaa be7anaw danda7enna” yaagis.
Niqodimoosi, “Ceega asi waanidi zaari yeletanaw danda7ii? Ba aaye ulo simmi gelidi zaari yeletanaw danda7ii?” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Taani new tuma odayis; oonika haathafenne Geeshsha Ayyaanape yeletonna ixiko, Xoossaa kawotethaa gelanaw danda7enna.
Asho na7atethi aawupenne aayipe yees; Xoossaa na7atethi Geeshsha Ayyaanape imetees.
Taani, ‘Hinte zaari yeletanaw bessees’ gada hintew odida gisho neeni malaaletofa.
Carkoy ba koyida bessi carkees. Neeni iya kooshincha si7asape attishin, I awupe yaako woyko aw biyako eraka. Ayyaanape yeletida ubbay hessa mela” yaagis.
Yaatin Niqodimoosi, “Hessi waanidi hananaw danda7ii?” yaagidi oychis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Neeni Isra7eeleta astamaare gidashe haysa erikii?
Taani new tuma odayis; nu eriyaba odoosinne be7idaba markatoos, shin nu markatethaa hinte ekeketa.
Taani hintew sa7aba odin hinte ammanonnaba gidiko saloba odin waatidi ammananee?
Salope wodhida Asa Na7aape attishin, salo keyday oonika baawa; [salon de7iya Asa Na7ay tana”]
yaagis.
Musey mela biittan Naase birata shooshi kaqidaysada tana ammanida ubbay merinaa de7uwa ekana mela Asa Na7ay dhoqu gaanaw bessees.
Xoossaa Na7aa ammaniya ubbay merinaa de7uwa laattanaape attishin, dhayonna mela Xoossay ha alamiya daro dosida gisho ba issi Na7aa immis.
Xoossay ba Na7aa ha alamiya kiittiday alamiya pirdanaw gidonashin alamiya iya baggara ashshanaasa.
Na7aa ammaniya oonika pirdetenna, shin Na7aa ammanonna oonika issi Xoossaa Na7aa ammanibona gisho ha77i pirdetis.
Pirdayka haysa: poo7oy alamiya yis, shin asaa oosoy iita gidiya gisho asay poo7uwape aathidi dhumaa dosees.
Iitabaa oothiya oonika poo7o ixees. Ayis giiko, ba oosoy qonconna mela poo7uwako yeenna.
Shin tuma oothiya oonika Xoossay kiitidaysada I oothidaysa poo7oy qoncisana mela poo7uwako yees.
Xammaqiya Yohaanisi Yesuusaba Markatis
Hessafe guye, Yesuusinne iya tamaareti Yihuda biitta bidosona. Yesuusi yan xammaqishe entara guutha wode uttis.
Qassi Yohaanisi Saleema matan de7iya Henoona giya bessan gidiya haathi de7iya gisho asaa yan xammaqees. Asayka yaa bidi xammaqetosona.
He wode Yohaanisi buroo qashetibeenna.
Hessafe guye, Yohaanisa tamaaretinne issi Ayhude addey
geeshsho wogabaa palamidosona.
Enti Yohaanisako bidi, “Astamaariyaw, Yordaanose Shaafape hefinthan neera de7eysi, neeni iyabaa markatidaysi, Heko xammaqees. Asa ubbayka iyako boosona” yaagidosona.
Yohaanisi zaaridi, “Xoossay immonna asi aybibaaka ekanaw danda7enna.
‘Taani Kiristoosa gidike, shin iyape sinthe kiitetas’ gidaysas taw hinte, hinte huuphen marka.
Gelos giigidaara ekenaw giigidaysasa. Ekeysa laggey iya matan eqidi I geysa si7iya wode daro ufaytees. Hessa gisho, haysi ta ufaysay poletis.
I gitatanaw taani guuxanaw bessees” yaagis.
Bollafe yeysi ubbaafe bolla. Sa7ape bentidaysi sa7aba. I sa7aba odees. Salope yeysi ubbaafe bolla.
I ba be7idabaanne si7idaba markatees, shin iya markatethaa ekey baawa.
Iya markatethaa ekiya oonika Xoossay tuma gideysa qoncisees.
Xoossay ba geeshsha Ayyaana iyaw kumethi immiya gisho Xoossay kiittidaysi Xoossaa qaala odees.
Aaway ba Na7aa dosidi ubbaba iya kushen wothis.
Na7aa ammaniya uraas merinaa de7oy de7ees. Shin Na7aa ammanonaysa bolla Xoossaa hanqoy de7eesipe attishin, I de7o demmenna.

footnotes.text: Salon de7iya Asa Na7ay tana: Issi issi beni maxaafati gujoosona.
Issi Ayhude Addey: Issi issi maxaafati “Guutha Ayhude asati” yaagosona.
